string-array.name: main_greetings_morning
string-array.item: Good morning. Shall we start the experiment?
Good morning. The lab is already up and running.
Coffee ready, flasks clean. Shall we begin?
Good morning. Mornings are great for tough ideas.
New day, new experiments.

string-array.name: main_greetings_afternoon
string-array.item: Good afternoon. The lab is ready.
Good afternoon. One more experiment?
The afternoon is long: give it a good pomodoro.
Good afternoon. The flasks are waiting for you.
Time to turn this afternoon into something worthwhile.

string-array.name: main_greetings_night
string-array.item: Good evening. One last experiment, then rest.
Good evening. The night lab is open.
The night is quiet: a great time to focus.
Good evening. Even the stars work the night shift.

string-array.name: main_greetings_late
string-array.item: Working in the small hours. Don\'t forget to sleep.
Late night at the lab. One pomodoro, then bed.
At this hour, only scientists and owls are still up.

string-array.name: main_finished_done
string-array.item: Reaction complete! Your focus was the best catalyst.
Activation energy overcome: starting was the hard part, and you did it.
Every pomodoro is an atom; today you built a whole molecule.
Like gold, your consistency doesn\'t rust.
Successful experiment. Marie Curie also started with a single sample.
Your brain just synthesized something valuable: time well spent.
Even noble gases need stability. Rest, you\'ve earned it.
Science moves step by step, and today you took several.
Positive result: focus really works. Repeatable and proven.
Carbon becomes diamond with pressure and time. You\'re on the right track.
Hypothesis confirmed: you\'ve got this.
Your lab smells like success. Well, and a little like coffee.
Newton had his apple; you had your pomodoro streak.
A chain reaction starts with a single step. You\'ve already taken many.
Not even helium gets past you: today you contained all your attention.
Great discoveries are consistency disguised as genius.
Today\'s data: more focus, fewer distractions. Excellent sample.
Your neurons formed some great bonds today.
Just as water carves stone, consistency carves results.
Experiment finished. Now hang up the lab coat and rest.

string-array.name: main_finished_big
string-array.item: Full lab shift complete! That was a high-yield experiment.
This many pomodoros deserve to be published in a scientific journal.
Today you were a focus reactor. Recharge well.

string-array.name: main_finished_none
string-array.item: The experiment didn\'t work out today, and that\'s okay: it\'s data too. We\'ll pick it up tomorrow.
Not every reaction happens on the first try. Come back whenever you like.
Edison tried thousands of filaments before finding the right one. Tomorrow is another trial.
